title: The Lord of The Ring's Lament: Don't Put All Your Eggs in One Ring
subtitle: A podcast-ified satire
body_html:
This is part of my ongoing entertainment of myself. I am taking my compliance and founder drama content about the Lord of the Rings and making equally dumb podcasts. I hope they are entertaining for you. Please review the show on Apple podcasts or Spotify with five stars. It’s a big deal. If you do, I’ll comp you a subscription for a year. Just ping me!

Thanks! Share if you enjoy it, and ignore it if you hate Fantasy-Parody Podcasts…this is mostly for Carlene, who hates these.

Also, remember, there is a 50% off special for subscriptions today!
